summary: First-iteration end-to-end testing for PericL voice journal app. Backend (14 pytest tests) and Frontend (9 Playwright scenarios) all PASS. AI integrations (Whisper STT, GPT-5.2 categorization, Gemini 3 Flash recap) verified live via Emergent LLM key. Auth gate, text/voice notes, timeline, item PATCH/DELETE, daily recap, theme toggle, and logout flow all work end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: get_current_user reads cookie OR Bearer header — correct. Sessions stored without TTL index — consider adding a TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at to auto-purge expired sessions.

server.py recap endpoint: type filter for 'voices' uses ['voice','text'] (notes), but the count field is named voice_count which is slightly misleading (it includes text notes). Frontend RecapDrawer labels it 'Notes' so user-facing is fine; consider renaming the API field to note_count for clarity.

server.py PATCH /items/{item_id}: on update success, returns full doc but does not check that the doc belongs to the current user when fetching back (find_one only uses id). This is a tiny information-leak risk — fix by adding user_id filter to the find_one after update. Update also currently scoped by user_id, so user can never patch someone else's item, but the return-fetch should still be scoped.

/notes/voice: when transcription form field is empty AND Whisper fails, note title falls back to 'Voice note' but transcription stored as empty string — acceptable for MVP, but could surface an explicit warning in response so UI can hint at transcription failure.

Frontend Journal.jsx: text/voice send appends extracted+note via local mutation; reverse() mutates the array passed to setItems. Works because extracted is fresh from API, but cleaner to spread a copy before reverse to avoid surprises if shared.
Frontend api client interceptor not visible in this diff; ensure 401 from /auth/me triggers redirect to /login (currently AuthContext appears to handle it).

seed_data_creation: Tests created several journal_items (text note 'Remind me to call mom...', text note 'Buy milk and eggs', voice note 'I'm feeling pretty focused today.') plus a daily_recap. All under the seeded test user. Voice/text empty-input rejection paths exercised.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_pericl_backend.py. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pericl_backend.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend test flow: inject session cookie session_token=test_sess_1777377818066 on domain pericl-staging.preview.emergentagent.com (httpOnly,secure,sameSite=None) then navigate to /. data-testids: login-google-btn, login-theme-toggle, app-header, dock-record-btn, dock-mode-text, dock-mode-voice, dock-text-input, dock-send-btn, header-recap-btn, header-theme-toggle, header-user-menu-trigger, header-logout, recap-drawer, recap-generate-btn, recap-close, item-toggle-{id}, item-delete-{id}, audio-{id}. AI calls (recap, categorize) take 5–10s — sleep accordingly.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. AI categorization correctly returns reminder/task/idea structured items; Gemini recap returns multi-sentence warm summary; Whisper transcription path verified via fallback transcription form-field (1s silent WAV with explicit transcription accepted).
